ruleDefinitions.name: Sysmon Channel Reference Deletion
ruleDefinitions.description: Potential threat actor tampering with Sysmon manifest and eventually disabling it Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectName, ObjectValueName, NewValue, AccessMask

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4657 AND (ObjectName = RGX(".*WINEVT\\\\Publishers\\\\\\{5770385f\\-c22a\\-43e0\\-bf4c\\-06f5698ffbd9\\}.*") OR ObjectName = RGX(".*WINEVT\\\\Channels\\\\Microsoft\\-Windows\\-Sysmon\\/Operational.*")) AND ObjectValueName = "Enabled" AND NewValue = 0) OR (event_id = 4663 AND (ObjectName = RGX(".*WINEVT\\\\Publishers\\\\\\{5770385f\\-c22a\\-43e0\\-bf4c\\-06f5698ffbd9\\}.*") OR ObjectName = RGX(".*WINEVT\\\\Channels\\\\Microsoft\\-Windows\\-Sysmon\\/Operational.*")) AND AccessMask = 65536))
